# Tabernacle Beauty

> Tabernacle Beauty (also listed as Tabernacle Beauty Service) is a calm beauty studio in Tampines, Singapore, offering brows, threading, facials, body waxing, hair treatments and colour, lash extensions, makeup, nails, and henna. Book on WhatsApp with Jessyca at +65 8457 4640.

Tabernacle Beauty helps people in Tampines and across Singapore look polished without guesswork: walk in bare-faced for a precise brow or facial, and leave camera-ready. The studio is run by Jessyca, who has 15+ years of threading experience. Clients rate the studio 4.9/5 on Google (100+ reviews). Eyebrow threading starts from $9 SGD, welcomes walk-ins, and is the most popular first visit. Other treatments are best booked ahead so each appointment stays unhurried.

Prices below are in Singapore dollars (SGD) and match the public price list. Where a men’s price differs, it is noted. Services marked “on request” do not have a fixed published price — message the studio for a quote. This file is the concise machine-readable summary. The same facts are on the HTML pages linked below.

## Core services

- [Brow styling](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/#service-brows): Shaping and definition mapped to the face. Related prices under threading.
- [Facial treatments](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/#service-facials): Personalised facials from classic to LED and bridal glow. [Price list](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/pricing.html#facials).
- [Body waxing](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/#service-waxing): Face, body, and Brazilian waxing. [Price list](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/pricing.html#waxing).
- [Creambath hair treatment](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/#service-creambath): Deep-conditioning creambath with scalp massage. Hair menu prices start with henna and treatment ranges. [Hair prices](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/pricing.html#hair).
- [Full face threading](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/#service-threading): Brows, lip, and full-face threading with cotton thread, no wax and no chemicals. [Price list](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/pricing.html#threading).
- [Eyebrow embroidery](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/#service-embroidery): Semi-permanent brow embroidery mapped to bone structure. Typical wear is 1–2 years, with a touch-up around 12 months. Quoted on request.
- [Hair coloring](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/#service-hair-color): Consultation-led colour from gloss to full transformation. [Hair prices](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/pricing.html#hair).
- [Henna eyebrow](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/#service-henna): Henna tint for depth and shape. Brow tinting is $28. [Threading prices](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/pricing.html#threading).
- [Eyelash extensions](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/#service-lashes): Custom sets for length, curl, and volume. Quoted on request. Aftercare: avoid water and steam for 24 hours, brush with a clean spoolie, and do not use oil-based removers.
- [Makeup](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/#service-makeup): Personal, bridal, engagement, birthday, and ROM makeup. [Price list](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/pricing.html#makeup).

## Frequently asked questions

Answers match the public FAQ at https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/#faq.

- Does eyebrow threading hurt? Most clients say it is far gentler than waxing. Jessyca uses a fine cotton-thread technique that removes hair from the root with minimal skin contact. First-timers regularly say they barely felt a thing. Any mild tingling fades within minutes, and there is no redness or irritation afterwards.
- How hygienic are the tools and studio? Every tool is sanitised between clients, and single-use thread is discarded after each session. The studio is cleaned throughout the day. Jessyca follows hygiene protocols developed over 15+ years. Safety is part of the service, not an extra.
- How long does eyebrow embroidery last? Results typically last 1–2 years depending on skin type and aftercare. A touch-up around 12 months keeps brows fresh. Each stroke is mapped to bone structure so the shape stays natural as it fades.

## Journal

Posts are on the blog page. Each link jumps to that note.

- [How to prep your skin before a facial](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/blog.html#prep-skin-before-facial): 15 March 2026. Arrive with clean skin, skip heavy makeup, mention retinol or acids when booking, and avoid direct sun for 24 hours afterwards. [Facials](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/pricing.html#facials).
- [Brow shaping: threading vs waxing](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/blog.html#threading-vs-waxing): 3 March 2026. Threading is precise and kinder around the eyes; waxing is quicker for a fuller reshape. [Threading](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/pricing.html#threading) · [Waxing](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/pricing.html#waxing).
- [Top 3 beauty trends in Tampines North for 2026](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/blog.html#tampines-trends-2026): 1 March 2026. Natural-looking lashes and skin-first facials.
- [Aftercare for eyelash extensions](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/blog.html#lash-extension-aftercare): 24 February 2026. Keep water and steam off for 24 hours; avoid oil-based removers.
- [Why regular body waxing is better than shaving](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/blog.html#waxing-vs-shaving): 18 February 2026. Waxing removes hair from the root so regrowth is slower and often finer.
- [Self-care Sunday: a spa day at home](https://www.tabernaclebeauty.com/blog.html#spa-day-at-home): 12 February 2026. A simple at-home ritual between studio visits.
